profile.summary: Eco Recycling Limited operates as an e-waste management company in India. It is involved in the recycling of waste electrical and electronic equipment, as well as extract materials, such as copper, aluminum, silver, and gold from complex electronic scrap. The company also offers reverse logistics services; onsite and offsite data destruction services, including deleting, degaussing, and destroying
